log_retention_days.title: Log Retention Period (Days)
log_retention_days.description: Number of days audit/security logs are preserved in hot, queryable storage. >= 90 is secure (CIS 8.10).

retention_schedule_enforced.title: Retention Schedule Enforced
retention_schedule_enforced.description: An automated, auditable retention schedule (ILM / lifecycle policy / retention-lock) enforces the retention window. Secure when true.

logs_stored_on_separate_system.title: Logs Stored on Separate System
logs_stored_on_separate_system.description: Logs are forwarded to and retained on a separate system in a distinct trust domain (NIST AU-9(2)). Secure when true.

centralized_log_aggregation.title: Centralized Log Aggregation
centralized_log_aggregation.description: All log sources are aggregated centrally under one retention policy (CIS 8.9). Secure when true.

audit_log_tamper_evident.title: Audit Logs Tamper-Evident
audit_log_tamper_evident.description: Stored audit data uses WORM/immutable retention-lock plus cryptographic integrity protection (NIST AU-9(1)/(3)). Secure when true.

log_pipeline_integrity_protected.title: Log Pipeline Integrity Protected
log_pipeline_integrity_protected.description: The log pipeline is integrity-protected end to end, in transit and at rest. Secure when true.

audit_management_restricted_to_privilege.title: Audit Data & Management Access Restricted
audit_management_restricted_to_privilege.description: Read access to audit data and audit-management functionality is limited to a privileged subset (NIST AU-9(4)). Secure when true.

log_access_monitored.title: Log Access Monitored
log_access_monitored.description: Unauthorized access, modification, or deletion of logs is alerted. Supporting context.

authenticated_log_forwarders_required.title: Authenticated Log Forwarders Required
authenticated_log_forwarders_required.description: Log forwarders mutually authenticate and transmit over a TLS-protected channel (vs plain UDP syslog). Secure when true.

log_storage_sized_for_retention.title: Storage Sized for Retention Window
log_storage_sized_for_retention.description: Logging destinations are provisioned and monitored to hold the full retention period so logs are not dropped early (CIS 8.3). Secure when true.

log_flood_overflow_protection.title: Log Flood / Overflow Protection
log_flood_overflow_protection.description: Capacity is monitored and alerted, with log-flood/overflow protection so rotation does not silently drop logs. Secure when true.

clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.title: Clocks Synced to Trusted Time Source
clocks_synced_to_trusted_time_source.description: Logging assets synchronize to >= 2 approved time sources so cross-source timelines are trustworthy (CIS 8.4). Secure when true.

secure_disposal_at_end_of_retention.title: Secure Disposal at End of Retention
secure_disposal_at_end_of_retention.description: Logs are securely sanitized (Clear/Purge/Destroy) at end of retention (NIST SP 800-88). Secure when true.
